globalNews.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
globalNews.summary: Planes in Poland, Spain, Bulgaria and Italy have been checked for explosives following separate threats.

globalNews.title: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after on-field collision
globalNews.summary: Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel dies aged 30 after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match.

globalNews.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
globalNews.summary: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.

globalNews.title: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
globalNews.summary: At least 38 people are killed in 24 hours and Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky warns dozens more could be trapped under rubble.

globalNews.title: Libya's top religious authority rules against wearing Nike clothes
globalNews.summary: The US company was named after the Greek goddess of victory, so the Dar al-Ifta said displaying its logo was unIslamic.

cryptoNews.title: US midterms: Prediction markets favor Democrats in key crypto races
cryptoNews.summary: Kalshi and Polymarket price a 75% chance of a Democratic sweep, days after markets misjudged Brazil’s runoff.

cryptoNews.title: Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen
cryptoNews.summary: Markus Thielen sees Bitcoin reaching $90,000 by year-end, questions institutional ETF demand and says Ethereum must do more for holders.

cryptoNews.title: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool
cryptoNews.summary: Hackers exploited compromised employee computers and stolen credentials to breach Binance’s wallet infrastructure, according to the exchange’s investigation.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin price defends $76K lows as analysts see stocks pricing in ‘political gridlock’
cryptoNews.summary: Bitcoin made modest gains at the start of Wall Street trading on Tuesday as markets awaited cues from the US midterm elections.

cryptoNews.title: What’s at stake for crypto as the US votes in the 2026 midterms?
cryptoNews.summary: Crypto groups spent about $176 million ahead of the US midterms, with control of Congress and the future of crypto legislation at stake.

aiNews.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
aiNews.summary: The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3  billion round led by Bessemer.

aiNews.title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
aiNews.summary: The first experimental feature under the tab will allow users to get recommendations based on what they're currently in the mood for.

aiNews.title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
aiNews.summary: At a moment when Anthropic's compute margins should be getting better, they’re getting worse.

aiNews.title: Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search
aiNews.summary: Schools choosing to restrict AI altogether will no longer be able to access Google Search, as AI features are now integrated into the search engine.

aiNews.title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
aiNews.summary: Apple's new App Store rules will require 18+ ratings for dating apps and AI companions that offer sexual or romantic content.
